title: priestley-dual-cover-topology
description: The Grothendieck topology J_ResLat on the category of distributive integral commutative residuated lattices, generated by Priestley covers: a family is a cover iff its Priestley-space dual is jointly surjective. It is the intrinsic cover topology that transports Stone-style clopen covers across Priestley duality on the priestley-space of prime filters.

category.description: the site's underlying category: distributive integral commutative residuated lattices

covers.description: the Priestley covers that generate the topology: families {l_i : L -> L_i} of ResLat_dist morphisms

family.description: the morphisms l_i : L -> L_i in the covering family

coverCondition.description: a family {l_i : L -> L_i} covers iff its dual {Spec(l_i) : Spec(L_i) -> Spec(L)} on priestley-space is jointly surjective; equivalently the joint kernel is trivial, intersection_i ker(l_i) = {1}, with Priestley-side cocycle conditions on overlaps

subcanonical.description: J_ResLat is subcanonical: every representable Hom_ResLat(-, M) is a sheaf, the sheaf condition reducing to gluing of continuous maps on Priestley spaces under jointly-surjective covers

intrinsic.description: not an externally imported fpqc/canonical topology; it arises from Jung-Rivieccio duality and Priestley dualizability transporting clopen covers across duality
